reported.quote: During the second quarter of FY27, sales were at INR1,61,000 million, registering a growth of 11.8% vis-a-vis Q2 FY26.
During the second quarter of FY27, sales were at INR1,61,000 million, registering a growth of 11.8% vis-a-vis Q2 FY26.
Gross margin was at 80.8% for the quarter, higher than the same period last year, largely on account of a better product mix and favorable currency tailwinds.
EBITDA for the quarter was INR47,439 million, an increase of 4.8% over Q2 last year.
Reported net profit after tax for Q2 FY27 was INR19,885 million, while adjusted net profit for the quarter was INR31,620 million.
Reported net profit after tax for Q2 FY27 was INR19,885 million, while adjusted net profit for the quarter was INR31,620 million.
For the first half, sales were at INR3,12,836 million, registering a growth of 11% over the first half last year.
In Q2 FY27, our Innovative Medicines sales were up 6.9% to reach USD356 million.
The sales of India formulations were INR55,523 million for the quarter, recording a growth of 17.3%.
Overall, the US business reported sales of USD455 million for the quarter, declining by 8.2%.
Our formulation revenue in Emerging Markets were USD350 million, up by 7.6% over Q2 last year.

reported.metric: Rest of the World formulation revenues
reported.quote: Formulation revenues in Rest of the World for the quarter were USD241 million, higher than Q2 last year.
Consolidated investments towards R&D for Q2 '27 stands at INR7,784 million or 4.8% of sales.
